name: Square Meal
text: After bidding, if your team's contract is 9 or more tricks, gain +1× contract multiplier.

signature.effect: +1× when the contract is 9 or more

archetypes: Bonus Chaser, Diamond Flood, Heart Chorus, Swap Meet, Contract Attacker; any contract deck
decision: Whether to stretch the team's bid to nine: the multiplier applies win or lose, so the stretch has to be makeable.
opponent: Visible from the bids; opponents see the doubled stakes and can bid and play to set a stretched contract.
aiNote: With a team estimate of eight tricks or more, bid up to reach nine.
rationale: A nine-trick contract needs two strong hands or a real stretch, so it is on in about a quarter of rounds (about +30 to +40 late), and it applies win or lose; it sits one rung below Gambler's Wheel (OR-R01, ten or more for +2×) and differs from True Aim, Balanced Yin-Yang, and Runner-Up Trophy, which check tricks, not bids.
deviation: Revision 1: replaced matching bids of 4 or more with a team contract of 9 or more.
